output.reply: Hi there, thanks for the suggestion! A dark mode that follows your system setting automatically is a great idea, and we've passed it along to our product team. We appreciate you telling us how often you have to switch it by hand. We'll let you know if it ships. In the meantime, you can try switching the theme in Settings to see if a manual option helps. Thanks for helping us improve Lumen!

Hi there, thanks for reaching out. Since your old inbox is no longer accessible, the reset link can't reach you there. Please reply from a contact method you still control, or send us the new work email address you want on the account, and we'll verify your identity and update the email on your Lumen account so you can sign in and reset your password. Once it's updated, you'll be able to use the new address for future sign-ins and reset links.

Thanks for reporting this. Sorry the pasted table is collapsing into one line. It worked last week, so this looks like a regression in Lumen web on Chrome 131. We've logged it for our team to investigate. As a workaround, try pasting as plain text with Ctrl+Shift+V, or paste into a code block. If you can, let us know whether it happens in a new private window or in another browser so we can narrow it down.

Hi, thanks for reporting this. Sorry the app is closing when you open notes with PDF attachments on iOS, especially with an exam on Friday. We're treating this as a high-priority bug. Could you tell us your iOS version, the app version, and whether the issue happens with every PDF or only some? In the meantime, you may be able to reach your files through the web version of Lumen in a browser, where the attachments should still be available. We'll update you as soon as we have more information.

Hi there, I'm sorry for the trouble with this charge. I understand you cancelled in March and have a confirmation email, and we'll look into the $120 annual charge right away. Could you reply with the confirmation email or its date and the account email address so we can locate the subscription? We'll review it as quickly as possible and follow up with you today. Thank you for your patience.

Hi Maria, thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the trouble with the duplicate charge. I've flagged the two $9.99 Lumen Plus charges dated the 3rd on your account for review. Once confirmed, we'll refund the duplicate to your original payment method. Refunds usually post within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank. If you can share the last four digits of the card or the transaction IDs from your statement, that will help us move faster. Best, Lumen Support

Hi, we're sorry you and your team are locked out right before your client presentation. We're investigating the 'Cannot reach server' errors now, even though the status page shows operational, so this may be specific to your account, network, or region. Please try reloading the app, switching networks or disabling VPN/proxy if you use one, and checking whether the web version loads. Reply with your account email and the approximate time the errors started so we can escalate this right away. We'll keep you updated as we learn more.

Hi, thanks for reporting this. Sync stuck on 'Syncing...' for three hours on both your phone and laptop, along with search returning no results, sounds like a real issue on our side and not something with your notes. We're looking into it now. Your notes should still be safe on the device, so please avoid deleting anything while we investigate. We'll follow up as soon as we have more information.

Hi there, thank you for reporting this right away. A login from an unfamiliar location and notebooks shared with an address you don't recognize are signs your account may be compromised. Please change your password now, sign out of all active sessions, and turn on two-factor authentication if you haven't already. Also remove the unknown sharing from the two affected notebooks. If you can't log in to do this, reply to this message and our security team will help you regain control of your account. Our team is reviewing your case now, and we'll follow up as soon as we can.

Thanks for the suggestion. A version history that shows who edited a note and when, including who removed a paragraph, would help your team a lot, and we've logged it as a feature request for our product team. In the meantime, if you need to recover deleted content, please let us know which note and roughly when the change happened, and we'll check whether a backup is available. We'll update you if this feature moves forward.

Hi there! You can change your display name by opening Settings, selecting Profile, and editing the Display name field. Save your changes and the new name will appear next to your future comments. If you want existing comments to show the new name too, let us know and we can look into it for you. Thanks for reaching out to Lumen support!

Thanks for flagging this. You're right that the footer word count shows 0 for notes containing only emoji. We've logged it as a low-priority bug and will look into how the counter handles emoji. We appreciate you taking the time to report it.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Yes, you can export your notes as Markdown files from Lumen. Open the app's settings, choose Export, select Markdown as the format, and confirm the export to download a copy of your notes. Since you're planning to travel, it's a good idea to do this before you leave and keep the file somewhere safe. If you run into any trouble during the export, just reply to this message and we'll help you out. Have a great trip!

Hi there, sorry for the trouble the recent update caused with the Settings menu. To turn off the weekly summary emails, open Settings, look for the Notifications or Email section, and switch off the weekly summary option. If you can't find it, reply and we'll walk you through it step by step.

Hi there! To share a notebook in Lumen, open the notebook, click the Share button (usually in the top-right corner), then enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite and choose their permission level, such as view or edit. They'll receive an invite link. If you can't find the Share button, let us know and we'll walk you through it.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry your account still shows the free plan after upgrading to Lumen Team, and that you were charged $48 while your teammates can't access shared notebooks. We've flagged the billing discrepancy for review so the correct plan is applied and the charge is verified. We're also looking into why your two new teammates can't see the shared notebooks. Could you confirm the email addresses of the teammates and the invoice or transaction ID for the $48 charge? We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi, thanks for reporting this, and I'm sorry you lost your meeting notes. Data loss is our top concern, so we're treating this as urgent. Could you tell us the browser or app version and platform you're using, and roughly when the spinner appeared today? Please also avoid retyping or closing the note until we've checked; we'll look into whether a recoverable copy exists on our side and follow up with you shortly.

Hello, thanks for reaching out. We can update your invoices so they show Brandt Logistics GmbH and VAT number DE123456789. Please check that the account's billing details are current, and we'll reissue the receipts with your company name and VAT ID. If you can confirm the billing address to include, we'll get this sorted for you.

Hola, lamentamos las molestias. Sentimos que no puedas iniciar sesión y que el correo de restablecimiento no te llegue. Revisa tu carpeta de spam o correo no deseado, y confirma que escribiste la dirección con la que te registraste en Lumen. Si después de eso sigues sin recibirlo, responde a este mensaje con tu dirección de correo registrada y revisaremos tu cuenta manualmente para ayudarte a recuperar el acceso.

Hello, thank you for reaching out and for the kind words about Lumen. Moving a note between notebooks: internal links that point to a note are tied to the note itself rather than its notebook, so they should continue to work after a move. Merging notebooks: notes keep their comments and edit history when merged, though you should confirm this on a small test notebook first, as you suggested. We recommend exporting a backup of your notebooks before any bulk reorganization. If anything behaves differently than described, reply to this ticket and we will look into it further.

Thanks for reaching out! We've noted your request for an Android home screen widget and shared it with our product team. We don't have a release date to share yet, but we appreciate the suggestion and will let you know if it moves forward. In the meantime, feel free to reply with any details about how you'd like the widget to work.

Thanks for flagging this, and we're sorry for the disruption. We're aware of 503 errors affecting access to Lumen and are investigating now. We'll post updates as we learn more. In the meantime, please note the time you first saw the error (around 9:15 AM) and whether any other offices or users are affected, as this will help our team. We'll be in touch shortly with an update.

Hi, I'm sorry the Lumen mobile app has been unavailable on three Monday mornings in a row. That's frustrating, and I understand why you're considering other options. I've escalated this to our engineering team to investigate the recurring Monday morning outage. In the meantime, you can try reopening the app after a few minutes or using the web version at Lumen's website. Could you tell me your device model, OS version, and the approximate time you saw the error? That will help us find the cause. Thank you for your patience.

Thanks for these suggestions! Pinning notes to the top of a notebook, a default font size setting, and extending trash retention from 30 to 60 days are all useful ideas. We've logged each one for our product team to review. We can't promise a timeline, but we appreciate you helping us improve Lumen.

Hi, thanks for reaching out. I'm sorry you're locked out and dealing with a broken two-factor device while needing your documents today. For your security, we can't bypass two-factor authentication over chat, but we can help you regain access through our verified account recovery process. Please reply with the email address on your account and any details that help confirm ownership, such as your last login date or the notes you created recently. Once verified, our team will walk you through restoring access and resetting two-factor authentication. The login lockout should also lift automatically after a short cooldown period. Tip: if you still have any saved recovery codes or a backup device, check those first. Thank you for your patience, and we'll prioritize your case.

Thanks for reaching out! Broken images after an Evernote import are usually a result of attachments not being carried over with the note text. You generally don't need to re-import everything. Try re-running the import from Settings > Import and make sure the option to include attachments is turned on, then check a few notes to confirm the images appear. If some images are still broken after that, reply with the names of an affected note and the import date, and we'll look into it further for you.

Thanks for reaching out, and good luck with your computer science degree! I'm not able to confirm a student discount for the Plus plan from here, so I don't want to promise one. I've passed your question to our billing team, who can tell you whether a student discount or other lower-cost option is available. In the meantime, our pricing page lists the current plan details. We'll get back to you soon.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out. Sorry to hear Lumen has been running slowly for you today. Could you tell us what device and browser or app version you're using, and whether the slowness happens with all notes or only certain ones? That will help us track down the cause. In the meantime, try refreshing the app or signing out and back in. We'll look into it as soon as we can.

Thanks for reaching out about Lumen for your 200-person team. We understand SSO with Okta is a hard requirement for your security team. We have logged your request for SAML-based single sign-on as a feature request and flagged it as important to your evaluation. I don't have a committed release date to share right now, so I don't want to give you a timeline I can't stand behind. I'm forwarding this to our account team, who can discuss current options, any interim alternatives, and what roadmap visibility we can offer. Please reply with your preferred contact and any timing constraints for your decision.

Thanks for the detailed report. We're sorry about both issues. The freeze when opening notebooks with more than 200 notes and the Ctrl+B bug inserting a literal 'b' are both bugs we want to look into. Could you tell us your Lumen desktop version and Windows build, and whether the Ctrl+B problem happens in every note or only some? We'll follow up as soon as we have more information.

Bonjour, merci pour votre message. Pour mettre à jour votre carte bancaire, ouvrez Lumen, allez dans Paramètres, puis Abonnement et Facturation, et sélectionnez Modifier le moyen de paiement. Si l'option n'apparaît pas, indiquez-nous votre adresse e-mail de compte et nous vérifierons cela pour vous. Cordialement, l'équipe Lumen.

Hi, thanks for reporting this. Sorry the share link lumen.example/s/ab12 returns a 404 for your coworkers. We're looking into it now. To help us reproduce it, could you confirm whether the notebook is still shared with link access turned on, and whether the link works when you open it while signed out? Please also tell us roughly when you created the link and which browser your coworkers are using.

Thanks for reaching out! Lumen doesn't currently have a built-in way to save a note as a template from the note menu, but you can get the same result by duplicating a note: open your standup note, use the note's options menu to make a copy, and rename it something like 'Standup Template'. Your team can then duplicate that copy each week to start a fresh set of standup notes. If you want the template shared, make sure the note is in a shared notebook or shared with your teammates. If you can't find the duplicate option in your version, let us know which platform you're on and we'll point you to the exact steps.

Thanks for the feedback! Sorting notes alphabetically is a reasonable request, and we've logged it for the product team to consider. We don't have a timeline to share yet, but we appreciate you taking the time to tell us what would make Lumen better.

Hi, thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear a $480 charge overdrew your account. We're treating this as urgent. Our billing team is reviewing your account to confirm the charge amount against your $48 plan and will correct any overcharge. If you can, please reply with the date of the charge and the last four digits of the card used, so we can locate the transaction quickly. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi there, thanks for reporting this and sorry for the trouble. We're sorry image uploads are failing with 'Upload failed, try again' since this morning while text notes still work. We've passed this to our engineering team to investigate. In the meantime, could you tell us your browser or app version and whether the failing images are particular file types or sizes? That will help us track it down. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Sorry the spellcheck keeps flagging 'Lumen' in your notes, that's clearly annoying. Our team has noted it as a bug. In the meantime, you can add the word to your spellchecker's personal dictionary (right-click the underlined word and choose 'Add to Dictionary' or 'Ignore'), which should stop it from being flagged. If it keeps happening after that, reply with your browser or operating system and we'll look into it further.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Switching from monthly to annual billing is easy. We don't have the exact proration details for your account in this message, so please check your Billing settings or let us know your account email and we'll confirm whether the annual charge applies immediately or starts when your current monthly period ends. Thanks for choosing Lumen!

Guten Tag, vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Gerne senden wir Ihnen die Rechnung für Mai als PDF zu. Bitte bestätigen Sie uns kurz die E-Mail-Adresse des Kontos, damit wir sie passend zuordnen können. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Ihr Lumen-Support-Team

We're sorry about the unexpected charge, especially after you cancelled two weeks ago. We're looking into your account now and will confirm whether the charge was made in error. If it was, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. We'll follow up with you shortly.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out. I can help you delete your Lumen account. Deleting your account permanently removes your profile, all of your notes, attachments, and synced data from our servers. Once the deletion is confirmed, it cannot be undone, so we recommend exporting any notes you want to keep first. Deletion is typically completed within 30 days, and backups are purged within a further 30 days. If you tell us the email address on your account, we can start the process or point you to the delete option in your account settings. Best regards, the Lumen Support Team

Hi, thanks for reporting this. Exact-phrase search returning notes that don't contain the phrase is a real problem, especially when you rely on it to find client names, and we're sorry for the disruption. We've logged it as a bug and passed it to our engineering team. In the meantime, you may find it helpful to search with the client name alone and scan the results. If you can share an example search term and one of the unexpected results (with any sensitive content removed), it will help us reproduce the issue. We'll keep you updated as we investigate.

Thanks for reporting this, and sorry for the annoyance. Checkboxes in your to-do notes toggling on their own while you scroll is not expected behavior. We've logged it for the Android team along with your app version, 5.2.1. To help us reproduce it, could you tell us the device model and Android version, and whether it happens in every note or only certain ones? In the meantime, updating to the latest version from the Play Store may resolve it if a fix has already shipped. Thanks for your patience.
Hi! You can change your password by going to Settings, then Account, and selecting Change password. If you don't see that option or run into trouble, reply here and we'll walk you through it.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Yes, you can use separate Lumen accounts for work and personal on the same phone. Simply sign out of your current account from the settings menu, then sign in with your other account's credentials. If you'd like to switch between them more quickly, you can add both accounts in the app's account switcher if your version supports it. Let us know if you run into any trouble.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out! Unfortunately we don't currently offer a way to merge two Lumen accounts directly. The simplest route is to export your notes from your old account and import them into your new work account. You can export from the account settings menu, and then use the import option in your new account to bring them across. If you run into any trouble with the export or import, just reply to this ticket and we'll be happy to help you through it.

Hi there, thanks for reaching out. Since your former teammate was the only admin, the workspace is locked out of admin actions, but we can help you regain control. Please reply with the workspace name, the admin account email on file, and proof that you're authorized to act for the company (such as a recent invoice or a company email domain verification). Once we verify this, our team will transfer admin rights to your account so you can invite members and manage the plan. Thanks for your patience.

Hi, thanks for reaching out! I'm checking the current steps for turning on offline mode, whether it covers notebooks shared with you by teammates, and the storage limit on the Plus plan. I'll send you the confirmed details shortly. In the meantime, you can find the plan comparison on your account's billing page. Let us know if anything else comes up.

Hola, gracias por escribirnos. Para cambiar el idioma de Lumen a inglés, abre Ajustes en la app, ve a la sección Idioma y selecciona English. Si no encuentras esa opción, dinos qué versión de la app y de tu teléfono usas y te ayudamos. ¡Saludos del equipo de Lumen!

Thanks for reaching out! Pasting a plain YouTube link usually shows as text. To embed the video, try pasting the link on its own line and waiting a moment so the preview loads, or use the embed or media option in the editor toolbar if you see one. If it still doesn't render, let us know which browser and device you're using and we'll look into it.

Thanks for reporting this, and I'm sorry you're locked out before an investor call. Since your colleagues in Berlin are seeing the same error, we're treating this as urgent and escalating it now. In the meantime, please try signing in from a private browser window with cookies cleared, and check lumen status updates for any ongoing incident. If you still can't get in within the next 30 minutes, reply here with your account email and the exact time of your last attempt so we can investigate right away.

Hi, thanks for reporting this. Please don't delete anything yet. Duplicate-looking notes are often a display or sync issue rather than duplicated data, and we want to make sure your originals are safe. Could you tell us which platform and app version you're using, and whether the duplicates appear on other devices or in the web app? Our team is looking into it, and we'll follow up soon with next steps to restore your notebook list.

Thanks for the suggestion! Adding due dates to checklist items and a calendar view would be useful for using Lumen as a task tracker. We've logged your request with our product team. We'll let you know if it moves forward, and we appreciate you helping shape Lumen.

Thank you for the detailed report. We're sorry this is disrupting classes across your district. We are treating this as a high-impact incident affecting multiple schools and are investigating now. We have not yet confirmed the root cause. Please note that we can't yet verify a workaround. In the meantime, avoid repeated sign-in attempts, since they may not help, and keep your teachers' lesson-plan content saved locally or in another location if possible. We will update your IT contact directly as soon as we have a confirmed status, and we'll notify you again when the issue is resolved. Please share any error messages, timestamps, or affected school names that would help our engineers.

Thanks for reaching out. We understand that exporting notes with an audit trail (who, what, when) in an archivable format is a requirement for your legal team, and we recognize the impact on your renewal next quarter. We've logged this as a feature request and flagged it for our product team with your renewal timeline. We don't have a confirmed release date to share yet, but we'll follow up with an update on our plans. In the meantime, please let us know if you'd like to set up a call with our account team to discuss your compliance needs and options.

Thanks for the suggestions! We've logged the word-count goal, the duplicate-note keyboard shortcut, more font options, and a larger app icon for our product team to review. We really appreciate you taking the time to share them.

Hi there, I'm sorry about your thesis notes. Please check Trash first: open Lumen, go to Trash in the sidebar, find the notebook, and select Restore. Deleted notebooks stay in Trash for a limited time, so act now. If it isn't in Trash, please reply with your account email and the approximate time of deletion, and our team will look into a recovery from backup as quickly as possible.

Thanks for reporting this. We're sorry real-time collaboration isn't syncing changes and cursors between you and your teammate. We've confirmed the issue and passed it to our engineering team. Could you tell us your browser and app version, and whether it happens on every shared note or only some? In the meantime, reloading the page will show the latest changes. We'll follow up as soon as we have an update.

Thanks for sharing this idea! Nested notebooks (like Work > Clients > Acme) would make organizing larger collections much easier, and we've logged your request with our product team. We can't promise a timeline, but feedback like yours helps shape what we build next. In the meantime, you can keep related notebooks together by using consistent naming prefixes such as "Work - Clients - Acme" so they sort together. Let us know if you'd like more tips on organizing your notes.

Hi, thanks for reporting this, and sorry you missed two deadlines because of it. Reminder push notifications stopping on iPhone since yesterday evening sounds like a bug on our side, since your reminders still appear when you open the app. We're looking into it now. In the meantime, please check that notifications are enabled for Lumen in iPhone Settings > Notifications, and that Focus or Do Not Disturb isn't blocking them. If you can, reply with your iOS version and the app version under Settings > About, and we'll follow up as soon as we have an update.
